description: Minimum design occupant load for a floor area from Ontario Building Code Table 3.1.17.1 area per person values. Preliminary planning figure only. The architect, the engineer and the permit set govern the occupant load used for design and approval.

area.description: Floor area for each use (required). Comma separated when several uses are given. Unit: unit.

use.description: Use of the floor area (required). One slug, or several separated by commas to match area.

name: occupant_load_calculator
